name: enforcement-level
wording: How firmly a value holds against override, as policy enforcement levels: advisory; firm, which the operator alone overrides; or fixed, which no persona or delegate overrides. Apart from that, a value is held by refusing an act only where the harm it prevents has been observed, is costly or irreversible, and whoever owns the decision can still get past it; then at the most reliable place that can hold it: a permission first, then a capability, then a check before the act takes effect. A reply shown as it is written has already taken effect, so no check refuses it. Every other value is held by the agent's own text, its breach visible but never refused.
reason: The operator: the design state a session reads was long human prose restating facts across concepts and carrying decisions with their situations; its reader is a model, so the state is the design alone, each concept as its established name and residue, and decisions and their reasons are history. Restated as its established name and residue, standalone, each fact in the one concept it belongs to, with the meaning standing decisions carried folded in.
